jobs.description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Senior Fullstack Engineer (Go / Kotlin & React)

About the Team

Merchant EMEA Engineering builds the technology that helps merchants join, grow, and operate successfully across our markets.

Our organization brings together the strengths of Wolt and Deliveroo and supports merchants across 37 countries. We work across the merchant journey, including onboarding, business growth and support, analytics and recommendations, menu and order management, integrations, and merchant applications.

Our teams sit close to the business. Rather than primarily building foundational platforms, we build products and features on top of our existing platforms to solve real merchant and market needs, including local business requirements, growth opportunities, and operational challenges.

📍This open role is based in our tech hubs in Helsinki or Berlin.

Please note: This role requires being based in Berlin/Helsinki on a hybrid basis. We are currently unable to offer fully remote work, visa sponsorship, or relocation support for this opportunity.

 

What You'll Do

As a Fullstack Engineer, you'll contribute to products and services used across the merchant experience. You'll:

  • Build and maintain production software across backend services and user-facing applications.
  • Work on areas such as merchant onboarding, analytics, recommendations, menu and order management, integrations, or merchant-facing tools.
  • Develop reliable APIs, data models, services, and user-facing features.
  • Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, operations, and other engineers to turn business needs into practical technical solutions.
  • Own features from implementation through production and ongoing maintenance.
  • Contribute to technical design discussions and improve the quality, scalability, observability, and maintainability of our systems.
  • Use AI-assisted development tools effectively as part of your engineering workflow, while critically evaluating their output and taking ownership of the final solution.
  • Be willing to work outside your primary area of expertise when needed to solve the problem end-to-end.

 

How We Work

  • Ownership: Engineers take responsibility for the features and services they work on, from development to production.
  • Collaboration: We work closely across engineering, product, design, data, and operations.
  • Pragmatism: We value simple and maintainable solutions that create business impact without unnecessary complexity.
  • Flexibility: We care more about solving the problem than strict frontend or backend boundaries.

 

Our Tech Stack

Our backend services primarily use Go and Kotlin, while our frontend applications use technologies such as TypeScript and React.

We also work with technologies including Kafka, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, gRPC, and modern cloud infrastructure.

 

Our Humble Expectations

We're looking for engineers who have:

  • An AI-first mindset, with a deep experience in leveraging modern AI tools and solid engineering principles to solve problems end-to-end, independently of any specific technology stack.
  • Proven experience building production software in backend, frontend, or fullstack environments end-to-end and at scale.
  • Strong expertise in at least one area of the stack, with a willingness to contribute outside that area when needed.
  • Experience with a modern backend language such as Go, Kotlin, Java, or similar, and/or modern frontend technologies such as TypeScript and React.
  • Good understanding of APIs, databases, testing, and software design fundamentals.
  • The ability to work independently on well-scoped problems and collaborate effectively with others.
  • Good communication skills and a pragmatic, collaborative mindset.

You do not need to be equally strong in frontend and backend. We welcome different balances of experience. You might be primarily a backend engineer who is comfortable making frontend changes when needed, or a frontend-focused engineer who is happy to work with APIs and backend services.

What matters most is that you are comfortable working across boundaries to deliver the right solution.

 

Nice to Have

Experience in one or more of the following areas would be a plus:

  • Merchant-facing or internal operational tools.
  • Analytics, recommendations, or decisioning systems.
  • Grocery, retail, restaurants, logistics, or marketplace technology.
  • Integrations with external business systems.
  • Kafka or other streaming technologies.
  • Cloud infrastructure such as AWS, Kubernetes, or Docker.

Why Join Us?

You'll work on products that directly affect how merchants interact with Wolt, Deliveroo and DoorDash across Europe. The scope is broad and close to the business, giving you the opportunity to work on meaningful problems across different parts of the merchant journey while developing your skills across the stack.

You can read more about our recruitment process here. here.

 

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you!

  • you reconverted from software engineering

  • By 3 months: You own at least one new-offering data pipeline end-to-end. Corresponding data points are available for self-service, and new metric definitions are live. You've automated at least one internal process using AI.

jobs.title: Data Center Security Risk & Assurance Senior Program Manager
Senior Data Scientist - Rankings & Recommendations (all genders)
jobs.description:
Your future team

You'll join Search Intelligence, the team behind Holidu's ranking and recommendation systems. With over 8 million vacation rental properties on the platform, your models will determine which of them our 70+ million annual users discover first — directly shaping search conversion and business results. It's one of the highest-leverage problems in the company — and we're not just maintaining a finished system: we're pushing the boundaries of what search at Holidu can do. You'll work with a large and rich dataset, fast paths from concept to production, and the autonomy to act on your own judgment.

Holidu is an AI-first company, and it shows in how we work: your modelling stays grounded in machine learning and statistics, but you'll have large-scale access to the best AI tools and the freedom to weave them into everything you do — from discovery to implementation to maintenance. Everyone here experiments and shares what works, and we'll count on you to help push how far AI can take us.

This role is based in Munich with two office days/week.

The ranking challenge at Holidu

Ranking at Holidu is already a deep system: a multi-stage pipeline with reinforcement-learning-based cold ranking, contextual re-ranking, and personalized recommendations, plus dedicated cold-start models for new properties with limited behavioral data. And it keeps expanding — we're starting to enrich our models with AI-generated semantic signals that describe what makes each home special, opening the door to smarter ranking and entirely new search experiences.The next generation of it is yours to figure out.

Some of the hard challenges we're tackling: balancing user relevance, conversion probability, and business value in a single ranking. Personalizing for users who are mostly anonymous or first-time visitors. Surfacing great new properties before any behavioral data exists — when a significant share of our inventory is new each quarter. And adapting our ranking to evolving partner and business models, where the right answer changes as the marketplace does.

Our Tech Stack

Python • Airflow • dbt • AWS (SageMaker, Redshift, Athena) • MLflow

 

Your role in this journey

You'll shape the ranking and recommendation systems that millions of guests rely on end-to-end. You will:

  • Develop high-impact models and improvements for our ranking, recommendation, and personalization systems — with the freedom to explore new, creative approaches.

  • Take models from conception to production, monitor their performance, and iterate to enhance accuracy and efficiency.

  • Design and run A/B tests as a core part of ranking development — ship experiments fast, learn from real traffic, and let winning ideas go live.

  • Collaborate closely with Product Managers and Software Engineers to identify, prioritize, and ship ranking improvements.

  • Ensure model reliability in production — online/offline agreement, drift KPIs, latency and uptime SLAs, and automated monitoring.

  • Take the technical lead on projects by driving direction, scoping initiatives, and guiding prioritization.

  • Continuously fold AI into how you work — finding smarter, faster ways to build, experiment on, and maintain your systems and workflows.

Your backpack is filled with

  • 3+ years of experience as a Data Scientist with a proven track record of applying ML models to solve real business problems.

  • Experience with ranking models or recommender systems is a strong advantage.

  • A quantitative degree in Machine Learning, Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, or a related field.

  • Strong foundations in statistics, predictive modelling, and machine learning, with hands-on experience in Python and SQL.

  • Hands-on experience with tree-based and gradient-boosting models (XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost) on large-scale tabular data.

  • A proactive, self-starting mindset — you love to own a domain and shape it end-to-end.

  • Genuine enthusiasm for using AI in your daily work — you experiment, adopt what works, and help move the boundaries of its usage.

Our adventure includes

  • Impact: Shape the future of travel with products used by millions of guests and thousands of hosts. At Holidu ideas become products, data drives decisions, and iteration fuels fast learning. Your work matters - and you’ll see the impact.

  • Learning: Grow professionally in a culture that thrives on curiosity and feedback. You’ll learn from outstanding colleagues, collaborate across disciplines, and benefit from mentorship, and personal learning budgets - with a strong focus on AI.

  • Great People: Join a team of smart, motivated and international colleagues who challenge and support each other. We celebrate wins and keep our culture fun, ambitious and human. Our customers are guests and hosts - people we can all relate to - making work meaningful and energizing.

  • Technology: Work in a modern tech environment. You’ll experience the pace of a scale-up combined with the stability of a proven business model, enabling you to build, test, and improve continuously.

  • Flexibility: Work a hybrid setup with 50% in-office time for collaboration, and spend up to 8 weeks a year from other inspiring locations. You’ll stay connected through regular events and meet-ups across our almost 30 offices.

jobs.description:
Aircall is a unicorn, AI-powered customer communications platform used by 22,000+ companies worldwide to drive revenue, resolve issues faster, and scale customer-facing teams. We’re redefining customer communications by bringing voice, SMS, WhatsApp, and AI together into one seamless workspace.

Our momentum comes from a simple idea: help teams work smarter, not harder. Aircall’s AI Voice Agent automates routine calls, AI Assist streamlines post-call work, and AI Assist Pro delivers real-time guidance so people can do their best work. The result is higher revenue, faster resolutions, and teams that scale with confidence.

Aircall is headquartered in Paris, our European HQ, with a strong North American presence anchored in Seattle, our North American HQ, and teams across Madrid, London, Berlin, San Francisco, New York City, Sydney, and Mexico City. We’ve built a product customers love and a business that’s scaling quickly, backed by world-class investors and driven by rapid AI innovation across multiple product lines.
At Aircall, you’ll join a company in motion. We’re ambitious, product-driven, and execution-focused, with visible impact, fast decisions, and real growth.

How we work at Aircall: We’re customer-obsessed, data-driven, and focused on delivering meaningful outcomes. We value ownership, continuous learning, and thoughtful speed. If you thrive in a collaborative, fast-moving environment where trust and impact matter, you’ll feel at home here.

About the Role:
 
As an Account Manager at Aircall, you are the owner of customer success and revenue growth across your portfolio. You drive Net Revenue Retention (NRR) by uncovering opportunities to expand, renew, and strengthen customer relationships. Acting as both the voice of Aircall for the customer and the voice of the customer within Aircall, you ensure our customers realize the full value of their investment while fueling sustainable growth for Aircall.
 
By deeply understanding the needs of our customers across a variety of industries and use cases, you become the trusted expert who identifies growth potential and helps improve the customer experience. This means translating customer goals into solutions that unlock adoption, value realization, and expansion — ensuring each account grows in both impact and partnership over time.
 
This is a highly strategic and commercial role — blending consultative relationship management with the rigor and energy of a quota-carrying seller. You’ll partner cross-functionally with Customer Engineering, Product, and Support to accelerate adoption, drive usage of add-on SKUs, and build deep, long-term relationships with customers at all levels of their organizations.
 
Aircall is undergoing an exciting transformation — building on our market-leading communications platform and introducing AI functionality that helps customers operate more intelligently, efficiently, and competitively. Join us and be part of shaping that journey.
 
This is a hybrid role, in office 3 days a week in Paris.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Own NRR: Manage the full post-sale lifecycle — driving renewals, expansions, and churn mitigation to deliver predictable and profitable growth.
  • Drive Growth: Identify and activate growth opportunities within your portfolio, prospecting into new subsidiaries, use cases, and additional SKUs to unlock untapped potential.
  • Target Strategically: Prioritize high-potential accounts that may have low spend today but represent strong expansion opportunities, developing long-term growth plans.
  • Prospect and Outbound: Run proactive outreach within your base to expand relationships and identify new value creation opportunities.
  • Develop Stakeholder Maps: Build and maintain multi-layer relationships — from daily users to senior decision-makers — ensuring alignment, sponsorship, and retention.
  • Sell Competitively: Position Aircall’s value head-to-head against competitors, with a clear understanding of how our solutions address each customer’s unique business needs.
  • Negotiate and Close: Lead complex renewal and upsell negotiations, balancing commercial outcomes with customer success to close revenue and foster loyalty.
  • Manage Pipeline & Forecast: Maintain an accurate pipeline of renewal and expansion opportunities and deliver consistent, data-driven NRR forecasting.
  • Partner for Adoption: Collaborate closely with your Customer Engineering counterpart to ensure customers achieve adoption milestones and measurable outcomes.
  • Champion the Customer Voice: Surface insights, pain points, and product feedback that inform Aircall’s product roadmap and go-to-market strategies.
  • Shape Local Strategy: Share learnings across teams to enhance customer experience and strengthen regional growth initiatives.

    • Qualifications:
  • Experienced in SaaS Account Management, Commercial Customer Success, or Renewal Management, with a track record of achieving revenue targets.
  • Skilled in consultative sales, prospecting, and negotiation, with the ability to balance commercial focus and customer advocacy.
  • Customer-obsessed — curious about how different industries and use cases leverage Aircall, and proactive in identifying ways to add value.
  • Capable of developing and executing account expansion strategies, including stakeholder mapping and whitespace analysis.
  • Confident in competitive sales cycles, able to articulate differentiation and handle objections effectively.
  • Analytical, detail-oriented, and accountable for forecast accuracy and pipeline hygiene.
  • Resilient, driven, and passionate about helping customers realize long-term value through partnership.

Staff Product Designer - Agents

Superhuman offers a dynamic hybrid working model for this role. This flexible approach gives team members the best of both worlds: plenty of focus time along with in-person collaboration that helps foster trust, innovation, and a strong team culture.

About Superhuman

Grammarly is now part of Superhuman, the AI productivity platform on a mission to unlock the superhuman potential in everyone. The Superhuman suite of apps and agents brings AI wherever people work, integrating with over 1 million applications and websites. The company’s products include Grammarly’s writing assistance, Coda’s collaborative workspaces, Mail’s inbox management, and Go, the proactive AI assistant that understands context and delivers help automatically. Founded in 2009, Superhuman empowers over 40 million people, 50,000 organizations, and 3,000 educational institutions worldwide to eliminate busywork and focus on what matters. Learn more at superhuman.com and about our values here.

The Opportunity

At Superhuman, we're on a mission to redefine how people communicate and get work done with AI. We're hiring an experienced Staff Product Designer to join the Agents team in Berlin.

We're designing entirely new interaction patterns around how AI and humans work together through agents, through writing, from fixing your grammar to helping you schedule meetings. We're looking for someone to help us on that journey, help us build out new agents across Grammarly and Superhuman Go, and really define what these modern interaction patterns will be. You'd be involved end to end, partnering closely with our engineering and product teams, from Kyiv to Silicon Valley.

In This Role:

  • Design zero to one agents. New writing and communication agents, built as AI-first products. A lot of the job is inventing interaction patterns that don't exist yet rather than applying ones that do.

  • Work with designers you'll learn from. The team spans San Francisco and Europe, with people who've come from some of the best product companies around. If you're looking for a design-focused environment with a lot of people to learn from, you'll get that here.

  • Pioneer new AI design workflows. The way we design is changing underneath us. We often start in code, refine in Figma, and ship frontend changes back into the codebase. We're defining that way of working as we go, and we want people who are excited to help build something that lets designers make whatever they can imagine.

  • Shape design strategy. Bring user insights, prototype ideas, and help build a longer-term view of where the Agents roadmap goes.

  • Lead and mentor. Raise the standard through critique, feedback, and working closely with less experienced designers.

Qualifications

  • Proficiency in industry-standard tools such as Figma and Claude Design is expected. The following outlines the skills and experience that will set exceptional candidates apart for this role.

  • Extensive experience designing complex, scalable software. The kind of tool people sit inside all day, so productivity tools, creative or CAD software, developer tools. Most of that depth lives on desktop, so mobile isn't a primary focus for this role.

  • A genuine interest in AI technology, both conceptually and in practical workflows like reading, writing and translating, and you're already experimenting with AI-driven prototyping.

  • You care about language and writing. Words are the product here, so we want someone who also thinks about how a sentence works, what makes writing sound like a person, and how tone shifts depending on who you're talking to, not just the interface around the words.

  • Comfortable working with metrics and data-driven design decision-making.

  • Bonus is having worked directly in code and shipped PRs to production.

Support for you, professionally and personally

  • Professional growth: We believe that autonomy and trust are key to empowering our team members to do their best, most innovative work in a way that aligns with their interests, talents, and well-being. We also support professional development and advancement with training, coaching, and regular feedback.

  • A connected team: Superhuman builds a product that helps people connect, and we apply this mindset to our own team. Our remote-first hybrid model enables a highly collaborative culture. We work to foster belonging among team members in a variety of ways. This includes our employee resource groups, Superhuman Circles, which promote connection among those with shared identities including BIPOC and LGBTQIA+ team members, women, and parents. We also celebrate our colleagues and accomplishments with global, local, and team-specific programs.

  • Comprehensive benefits for candidates based in Germany: Superhuman offers all team members competitive pay along with a benefits package encompassing life care (including mental health care and risk benefits) and ample and defined time off. We also offer support to set up a home office, wellness and pet care stipends, learning and development opportunities, and more.

  • Relocation Support: Superhuman provides comprehensive relocation support to make your move to Berlin seamless. Our package includes visa assistance, destination services to help you and your family settle in comfortably, and a relocation bonus to cover additional expenses, such as temporary housing.

We encourage you to apply

At Superhuman, we value our differences, and we encourage all to apply. Superhuman is an equal-opportunity company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race or ethnic origin, religion or belief, gender, disability, sexual identity, or age.

For more details about the personal data Superhuman collects during the recruitment process, for what purposes, and how you can address your rights, please see the Superhuman Data Privacy Notice for Candidates here.

Your primary mandate is pushing the company’s AI strategy forward: identifying use cases across departments, engineering production-grade AI and automation solutions, and helping to build the firm's AI governance practice. You will also contribute to the data platform that underpins Finance, Operations, and Risk reporting, since AI work at our company sits directly on top of that platform. 

This is a hybrid role for someone who is equally comfortable in a stakeholder workshop and an IDE. The work potentially spans AI agents and copilots, deterministic automation, RAG systems, and the data infrastructure they rely on. You will be expected to push back on bad use cases as much as you ship good ones. 

What you will do: 

AI & Automation Engineering 

  • Work with stakeholders across Compliance, Trading, Operations, Legal, Sales, and Finance to identify, scope, and prioritize use cases that genuinely move the needle. 
  • Engineer production data solutions: Deterministic automations, AI agents, RAG systems over internal documents, structured extraction pipelines. 
  • Build the firm's "innovation lab" environment where new use cases can be prototyped and evaluated. 
  • Maintain prompt and skill libraries as reusable, version-controlled assets, not as one-off scripts. 

AI Governance and Inventory 

  • Maintain the firm-wide inventory of AI systems and use cases, including those built outside D&A. 
  • Run the operational side of the company’s AI approval process: documentation, risk classification, model cards, evaluation artifacts. Policy is set at the executive level; you make sure the operational practice meets it. 
  • Conduct technical review of new AI initiatives proposed elsewhere in the company; advise on scope, risk, and design choices. 

Data Engineering and Platform 

  • Contribute to ELT pipelines on the Dagster + SQLMesh + dlt stack, primarily where AI & automation use cases require new data sources or transformations. 
  • Build the data substrate that AI workloads consume; feature views, document indexes, and structured event tables.  
  • Maintain infrastructure as code in Git with proper review and deployment standards. 

 

Requirements

  • 3–6 years of relevant experience. We are flexible on title, could be AI engineer, analytics engineer with AI focus, or data engineer who is pivoted to AI. What matters is shipped work. 
  • Demonstrable production experience with LLM applications: at minimum structured extraction with LLMs, and agentic patterns (tool use, multi-step workflows). You can describe what failed and what you learned. 
  • Strong Python; comfortable building production ready code, not just notebooks. 
  • Working knowledge of evaluation discipline for LLM applications (eval sets, regression tests, observability), conceptual understanding of retrieval, and how to handle hallucination. 
  • Familiarity with at least one orchestrator (Dagster, Airflow, Prefect) and one transformation framework (SQLMesh, dbt).

jobs.description:
Deine Rolle

Wir sind ein kleines, agiles Marketing-Team. Jede und jeder übernimmt hier Ownership, entwickelt eigene Strategien und setzt sie selbst um. Du verantwortest Growth-Projekte end-to-end, auf bestehenden Kanälen und auf neuen, die Du selbst findest. Du baust selbst, stellst selbst live in der App, im App Store oder auf der Website, und wertest die Daten danach aus. Die Wege sind kurz, der komplette Projektzyklus liegt bei Dir.

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Chancen in unseren Produkten finden. Du gehst regelmäßig durch Website, App Stores, Content, Jobboards und den Funnel bis Premium und findest die Stellen mit dem größten Hebel für Registrierungen und Umsatz.
  • Chancen im Markt erkennen. Du schaust genauso nach außen: Welche Trends und Plattformen bewegen unsere Zielgruppe gerade, welche Segmente oder Märkte lohnen einen Einstieg, welche Wachstumskanäle sollten wir aktivieren, die wir heute nicht nutzen, und was machen Wettbewerber.
  • Chancen bewerten und priorisieren. Du schätzt vorher ab, was realistisch drin ist und was es bringt, und bringst eine Shortlist ins Team. 
  • Selbst bauen und selbst live stellen. Du baust Landing Pages, Tests und Kampagnenbausteine mit AI und veröffentlichst sie selbst. Kein Ticket bei Engineering, kein Warten auf Design, keine Warteschlange. 
  • Testen und messen. Du setzt A/B-Tests auf der Website, in den App Stores und auf unseren weiteren Plattformen auf, wertest sie sauber aus und iterierst. 
  • App Store Optimisation. Du testest Screenshots, Icon, Titel und Beschreibungen laufend weiter.
  • Akquisition und früher Funnel. Dein Fokus liegt auf der Gewinnung neuer Nutzer. Gemeinsam mit dem Product Team bewertet Ihr, welche Zielgruppen und Kanäle den besten LTV bringen, und verbessert danach die Signup- und Activation-Flows im frühen Funnel.
  • Copy und Botschaften. Du formulierst, was StudySmarter Lernenden bringt, so dass es bei unserer Zielgruppe ankommt und konvertiert. Headlines auf Landing Pages, Ad-Copy, Video-Skripte, Plakatmotive und mehr. 
  • Content und Kampagnen mit AI. AI-Content-Projekte, Markenaufbau für unsere Jobboards, Out-of-Home-Kampagnen.
  • Love Brand aufbauen. Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit uns eine globale Love Brand für B2C und B2B und prägst mit, wie StudySmarter aussieht und klingt.


Was die Rolle nicht ist

  • Keine klassische Designstelle. Geschmack und Markenurteil sind wichtig, die handwerkliche Ausführung läuft über AI und Freelancer.
  • Kein Performance-Marketing-Job. Kanäle, Budget, Bidding und Attribution liegen an anderer Stelle im Team.
  • Keine Briefing-Rolle. Du machst die Arbeit selbst, statt sie weiterzugeben.
  • Keine Product-Rolle. Du bist kein Product Manager. Du trägst die Nutzerakquisition und arbeitest dafür eng mit dem Product Team zusammen, ohne Produktverantwortung zu übernehmen.
  • Keine Führungsrolle. Du arbeitest eng im Marketing-Team und gemeinsam mit dem Gründerteam, führst aber keine eigenen Mitarbeitenden. Dafür deutlich mehr Gestaltungsspielraum.


Was du für diese Rolle brauchst

  • Starke AI-Skills. Du arbeitest täglich mit AI-Tools wie Claude Code, Codex oder ähnlichen, dazu mit Agents und Automatisierung. Du baust eigene Seiten, Tools und Workflows und bringst sie selbst live, statt nur Prompts zu schreiben.
  • Starkes Copywriting und Storytelling. Du schreibst Texte, die auffallen und konvertieren, und findest die
    Worte, die bei Schülerinnen, Schülern und Studierenden ankommen. Du denkst in Geschichten und Nutzen, nicht in Feature-Listen.
  • Eigenständigkeit und Tempo. Du nimmst ein Thema und bringst es durch. Zehn Dinge live und gemessen sind Dir lieber als zwei perfekte. Zahlenverständnis. Du liest Funnel selbst, arbeitest in Analytics-Tools und bewertest Tests ehrlich, auch wenn
    das Ergebnis gegen Deine Idee spricht.
  • Ein Auge für Design. Du erkennst, was gut aussieht und was nicht, und kannst einschätzen, wann Design
    Conversion bringt und wann es nur Dekoration ist. Figma ist Dir vertraut.
  • Marketing-Grundverständnis. Du weißt, wie Paid, SEO und Lifecycle grundsätzlich funktionieren. Die Details der einzelnen Kanäle lernst Du bei uns.
Zwei Dinge sind Voraussetzung:
  • Deutsch auf Muttersprachniveau. Du schreibst für unsere Zielgruppe auf Landing Pages, in
    Ads, in den App Stores und offline. Ohne echtes Sprachgefühl funktioniert das nicht.
  • Eigene Projekte, die Du zeigen kannst. Seiten, Tools, Content, Nebenprojekte. Das sagt uns
    mehr als ein Lebenslauf.

Wir schauen auf Skills, Execution, Tempo, Kreativität und Ambition, nicht auf die Anzahl der Berufsjahre. Starke

Director of Product, Workflows

CreatorIQ is the software enterprise brands and agencies run their creator marketing programs on. A large customer works with thousands of creators a year across dozens of programs and several markets, and every one of those partnerships has to be sourced, vetted, agreed, briefed, tracked and paid for. You'll own that operational core and lead the product teams that cover it today, accountable for making the whole thing feel like one operation instead of a series of handoffs.

The mandate is to rebuild that operation around AI. Tooling in this category, ours included, was designed for a world where a person did each step by hand, and it still assumes that. It scales by adding people. A community manager keeping a 2,000-creator program on track lives in spreadsheets. An agency casting 300 creators against a brief in a week gets there by throwing bodies at it. Your job is to change what the software is responsible for, so programs scale without the headcount and the people running them spend their time on decisions that need judgment.

 

In this role, you’ll get to:

  • Own the workflow end to end. Discovery, Lists, Community, Campaigns and Messaging are one continuous job for our customers, and today they feel like separate products. Making them one, and making most of it happen without a human clicking through it, is the mandate.

  • Lead and grow a team of product managers. You'll set the bar for how they work, coach them on discovery and judgment, and give them enough room to own their surfaces without you in the middle of every decision.

  • Decide what gets rebuilt agentically, what gets simplified, and what gets deleted. Plenty of our existing workflow exists because someone needed a manual solution in 2020. Some of it should be automated, some should be replaced by a better model of the problem, and some should just go away.

  • Get the trust model right. Provenance, confidence, human-in-the-loop review, honest failure, and clean rollback are what decide whether an enterprise customer lets an agent touch a live campaign.

  • Partner with engineering and design leadership on architecture and delivery. Schema, core service, bulk operations, permissions, the data model that both the UI and the agents read from. You need to be credible in those conversations, not just present for them.

Who you are and what you’ll need for this position:

  • You've spent 8+ years in product, including 2+ leading product managers. Titles matter less than the work, but we need someone who has managed PMs before and knows the difference between coaching and taking over.

  • You've owned a broad, workflow-heavy B2B SaaS surface where the product is the customer's daily job.

  • You have a builder's mindset and haven't stopped being hands-on. You prototype. You use AI tools to build the thing rather than write a doc about the thing, and you expect the same from your team.

  • You've rebuilt a manual workflow around AI and know the difference between removing the work and putting a chat box in front of the same twelve clicks. You're fluent in the mechanics too: retrieval, tool use, evaluation, human-in-the-loop review, and where an agent shouldn't be allowed to act alone.

  • You have real product taste and you use it on AI output. You can look at an agent's plan, a generated brief, or a search result and say why it's good or why it's plausible-sounding filler. You ask the same question of a big customer's request or an inherited roadmap item: does this actually solve the problem?

  • You're technical enough to hold your own on data model and API design. Schemas, CRUDL, bulk operations, permissions, third-party integrations. You can tell when a small-sounding request is touching something structural.

  • You can prioritize across teams with genuinely competing claims and explain the tradeoff so the people who lost the argument still understand it.

  • You write well. Most of how we work is async and in docs, and a Director who can only communicate in meetings will not scale here.

  • You take initiative and own outcomes. You don't wait to be told the priority, and you'd rather bring a proposal than a list of questions. You're curious, self-driven, low-ego, and allergic to "that's not my job."

  • Comfortable working with distributed teams across time zones. Most work is async and flexible, but occasionally we'll ask for a later call.

Nice to have

  • Experience with influencer marketing, creator workflows, or martech.

  • Experience building search, discovery, or recommendation products, including semantic or multimodal search.

  • Experience shipping CRM, relationship management, or lifecycle products.

  • Experience shipping AI features into enterprise accounts where governance, auditability and permissions were part of the deal.

  • Experience hiring product managers and building a team from a partial bench.

 

Confidence can sometimes hold us back from applying for a job. But we'll let you in on a secret: there's no such thing as a 'perfect' candidate. Have 50% of the criteria? Excited about this opportunity? Passionate about what we do at CreatorIQ? Please apply! CreatorIQ is a place where everyone can grow.

 

What you will get from us:

  • People: Work with talented, collaborative, and friendly people who love what they do.

  • Guidance: Utilize our learning platform to fully get the training and tools you'll need to become successful here from your first day with us.

  • Work/life harmony: 25 days of vacation, floating and company holidays, wellness benefits, and paid parental leave.

  • Whole Health Package: Comprehensive healthcare coverage, including medical, dental, vision, mental health support, life insurance, income protection, and other wellness benefits.

  • Planning for the future: A Royal London Pension Plan to help you plan ahead.

Who we are:

CreatorIQ is the operating system for creator-led growth, helping global brands and agencies transform creator marketing into an intelligence-driven growth engine. Powered by the Creator Graph™, which processes more than 250 million social posts daily across more than 15 million creators worldwide, CreatorIQ unifies fragmented platform data into a centralized intelligence layer and system of record for creator relationships, performance, governance, and commerce. More than 1,300 organizations—including Dentsu, Delta Air Lines, Google, Beiersdorf, Nestlé, and Wella—rely on CreatorIQ as the infrastructure to run and scale their creator programs globally. The team is newly formed and set to grow, with a mix of internal and external engineers. Together with your Product Manager, you shape both the experiences we ship and the team that builds them, bringing joy to millions of children worldwide. Ready to help us create the future of audio play?


Your tasks and responsibilities will include:

  • Building & Scaling the Team: You grow the team as our roadmap grows: shaping the profiles we hire, onboarding and integrating external engineers, and making sure critical knowledge stays with the team rather than walking out the door.

  • Strategic Product Alignment: You act as the bridge between engineering and product strategy. You translate business goals into technical reality and collaborate seamlessly across departments to keep our roadmap both ambitious and achievable.

jobs.title: (Senior) AI Product Engineer – Agentic Experience
jobs.description:
Holidu is one of the world’s fastest-growing vacation rental technology companies. Our mission is to make booking and hosting holiday homes free of doubt and full of joy, by helping hosts generate more bookings with less work and helping guests find a holiday home they truly enjoy. Our team of 700 colleagues from 60+ nations shares a passion for tech, an ambition for constant improvement, and a relentless drive to bring the best experience to more than 40k vacation rental hosts and 4 million annual guests.

Your future team

We're looking for senior software engineers who multiply their impact through agentic coding. You'll own entire problem spaces, ship fast by leveraging tools like Claude Code, and work on the most strategic parts of Holidu's future. You'll build AI agents that serve Holidu's 4M guests and 55k+ hosts, and shape what's possible with AI in the vacation rental space.

If you have a builder's mindset, love to own problems, think outside the box, and have a strong engineering background, this role is for you.

Your team works directly with the Co-founder and CTO.

The Context

Holidu connects 4 million guests with 55k+ vacation rental hosts every year. Our Agentic Experience team is a small, fast-moving group inside Holidu's 200-person Engineering organization, rethinking how users interact with our platform using AI, how we build applications, and how we design agentic systems, with a lot of first-principles thinking along the way.

Today our agents handle thousands of real conversations across WhatsApp, email, in-product chat, and the help center, with the surface area expanding into adjacent products and internal tools. We're not running playbooks or following standard processes. We innovate and move radically fast.

Your role in this journey

  • Own problems, not tickets. You won't be handed a backlog. You'll be handed challenges like "our hosts spend too much time on guest communication" or "we need to understand why conversion drops here" and you'll figure out what to build.

  • Compound your impact. We measure output in customer impact, not lines of code. You'll take entire problem spaces from idea to production, often in days, and use agentic coding to keep raising your own throughput.

  • Work at the frontier. You'll design multi-agent systems with tool calling, handoffs, and production evals that handle thousands of real conversations, automate complex workflows, and push the boundaries of what's possible with LLMs in production.

  • Decide what's worth building. You won't just argue for the right tool. You'll argue for the right problem. We expect you to push back on roadmaps that don't make sense and propose ones that do. Our stack runs on Kotlin/Java, AWS, Kubernetes, ReactJS, PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, and Redis, with workflow-automation tooling and the Model Context Protocol stitching agents to the rest of the platform, across several repos. You won't hesitate to introduce the right tool for tomorrow.

Your backpack is filled with

  • A product mindset. You think in products, not features, and ask "what problem are we solving?" before "what should I build?".

  • Comfort with ambiguity, energized by ownership.

  • 5+ years of backend development experience, including time spent owning systems beyond the feature you shipped last.

  • Deep fluency with AI coding tools like Claude Code, with a clear sense of where they help, where they don't, and how to compound their impact across everything you build.

  • A track record of shipping production systems and the experience to keep them running.

  • Strong fundamentals across systems design, reliability, and production operations (we mostly use Kotlin, but the language matters less than the thinking).

  • Clear communication with code, in documents, and in conversation.

Our adventure includes

  • Impact: Shape the future of travel with products used by millions of guests and thousands of hosts. At Holidu ideas become products, data drives decisions, and iteration fuels fast learning. Your work matters, and you'll see the impact.

  • Compensation & Perks: A very competitive senior package plus travel benefits, gym discounts, and other perks to keep you energized.

  • Learning: Grow professionally in a culture that thrives on curiosity and feedback. You'll learn from outstanding colleagues, collaborate across disciplines, and benefit from mentorship and personal learning budgets with a strong focus on AI.

  • Great People: Join a team of smart, motivated and international colleagues who challenge and support each other. We celebrate wins and keep our culture fun, ambitious and human.

  • Technology: Work in a modern tech environment. You'll experience the pace of a scale-up combined with the stability of a proven business model, enabling you to build, test, and improve continuously.

  • Flexibility: Work a hybrid setup with 50% in-office time for collaboration, and spend up to 8 weeks a year from other inspiring locations.

Need a sneak peek?

jobs.description:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

About the job

Mistral AI is looking for a Domain Expert in crashworthiness simulations to help build AI-accelerated simulation capabilities for industrial engineering.

You will work at the intersection of industrial simulation, physics modeling, machine learning, and engineering workflows. Your role is to bring deep solid-mechanics expertise into the design, training, evaluation, and deployment of AI Physics Models for real engineering use cases.

This is a hands-on technical role. We are looking for someone who understands industrial structural simulation not only conceptually, but through direct experience with simulation models, solver workflows, data generation, validation, and engineering decision-making.

You will work with research, product, and customer-facing teams to ensure that our models are useful against real engineering standards — not only benchmark metrics.

Relevant application areas may include automotive crashworthiness, aerospace structures, consumer-electronics drop/reliability, manufacturing, durability/fatigue, and other nonlinear structural mechanics problems.

What you will do

  • Work with our research team to define, generate, and iteratively improve simulation datasets for training and evaluating crashworthiness foundation models, balancing coverage of relevant physical scenarios, simulation fidelity, and computational cost.

  • Design and run high-fidelity simulation campaigns using structural mechanics solvers such as Abaqus, LS-DYNA, Ansys Mechanical, Radioss or equivalent tools.

  • Define the relevant variation space for training data: geometry, mesh resolution, material behavior, boundary conditions, loading, contact, joints, failure modes, and engineering KPIs.

  • Build or guide automated pipelines for simulation setup, execution, post-processing, dataset creation, and model evaluation.

  • Work with research teams to train and evaluate AI models on simulation data, and diagnose failure modes caused by data gaps, poor coverage, numerical artifacts, or model limitations.

  • Evaluate model outputs against industrial engineering needs, including field-level accuracy, scalar KPIs, deformation modes, load paths, energy absorption, stress/strain fields, failure indicators, uncertainty, and out-of-domain behavior.

  • Work with industrial customers to understand their simulation workflows and engineering priorities, define use cases and success criteria, and incorporate their feedback into model development and validation.

About you

  • You have deep expertise in crashworthiness, solid mechanics, and structural mechanics, with substantial experience in industrial simulation workflows.

  • You have a Master’s degree or equivalent technical depth in mechanical engineering, aerospace engineering, civil/structural engineering, computational mechanics, applied physics, or a related field.

  • You have 4+ years of relevant industrial experience (or PhD +1 years) in domains such as automotive, aerospace, and consumer electronics.

  • You have hands-on experience with explicit dynamics for crash or impact simulation and understand nonlinear FEM and related topics such as contact, plasticity, structural dynamics, buckling, material modeling, fracture/damage, fatigue, crashworthiness, or durability.

  • You have direct experience with simulation validation, correlation, model quality, numerical sensitivity, and engineering KPI definition.

  • You are a strong Python developer who can build and maintain reliable tools for simulation automation, data processing, and model evaluation. You apply sound software engineering practices, including version control with Git, automated testing, code review, and clear documentation.

  • You have hands-on experience working in Linux and HPC environments, including submitting and monitoring batch jobs, selecting appropriate compute resources, and troubleshooting simulation workflows. You can run simulation campaigns efficiently across a compute cluster.

  • You are comfortable operating in ambiguous technical environments and turning poorly defined industrial problems into scoped datasets, experiments, metrics, and execution plans.

  • You communicate clearly with both deep technical experts and non-specialist stakeholders.

It would be great if you

  • Have experience applying machine learning, surrogate modeling, reduced-order modeling, optimization, or data-driven methods to simulation problems.

  • Have contributed to reusable internal tools, open-source code, simulation automation frameworks, or production-quality engineering workflows.

  • Have experience working directly with industrial customers, product teams, or engineering decision-makers.

  • Have publications, patents, internal technical leadership, or recognized contributions in engineering, simulation, computational mechanics, or ML-for-physics communities.

Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

jobs.title: Campaign & Account Manager DACH (M/F/D) - Mandarin (C2/ native level)
jobs.description:
Willkommen bei LunyOne - wir sind eine dynamische Influencer Marketing Agentur, die sich auf Tech, (Mobile-)Gaming, Entertainment und Lifestyle fokussiert. Mit unserer Tech-Unit LunyTech bauen wir den Bereich Consumer Electronics gerade massiv aus - und Du übernimmst dabei eine Schlüsselrolle.

Viele unserer Kunden sind chinesische Tech Brands, deren Entscheidungen im Headquarter in China fallen. Abgestimmt wird über Feishu/Lark und WeChat, auf Mandarin - und genau in dieser Übersetzungsschicht verlieren Agenturen im DACH-Markt normalerweise Zeit und inhaltliche Schärfe. Wir wollen das ändern: mit Dir als direkten Draht zwischen den chinesischen HQs und unseren KOL Kampagnen in Deutschland, Österreich und der Schweiz.

Tasks

Deine Aufgaben

Campaign Management (Dein Kern)

  • Briefings übersetzen: Aus HQ-Briefings, Produktinfos und Kampagnenzielen machst Du Creator-Briefings, die in DACH funktionieren: sprachlich, kulturell, plattformgerecht.
  • Kampagnen steuern: Creator-Auswahl, Timings, Content-Freigaben, Livegang, Reporting. Gemeinsam mit unserem Campaign-Team und mit eigener Verantwortung für Deine Accounts.
  • Erwartungen managen, in beide Richtungen: Du erklärst dem HQ, warum ein Creator hier etwas anders umsetzt, und dem Creator, worauf der Kunde Wert legt.
  • Reportings: Ergebnisse, Learnings und Empfehlungen bereitest Du so auf, dass Entscheidungen im HQ schneller und mit weniger Reibung fallen.
  • Events: gamescom, IFA, Kundentermine (auch in China). Du bist dabei, wenn Brand, Creator und Community zusammenkommen.

Account Management (wächst mit Dir)

Bringst Du bereits Account-Management Erfahrung mit, kann dieser Teil vom ersten Tag an größer sein.

  • Account-Ownership: Du betreust Deine Kunden über die einzelne Kampagne hinaus, als feste Ansprechperson für das HQ in China und die lokalen Teams.
  • Kulturelle Gaps schließen: Du erkennst früh, wo Erwartungen auseinanderlaufen, und moderierst (kulturelle) Unterschiede bei Feedback-Prozessen, Content-Freigaben und Content-Standards. Statt stur Wort für Wort zu übersetzen, vermittelst Du den Kontext und verhinderst Reibungsverluste, bevor sie entstehen.
  • Planung mit dem HQ: Du stimmst Launch-Kalender, Quartalsplanung und Budgets ab und sorgst dafür, dass DACH über uns als KOL Agentur früh genug im Plan des HQ auftaucht.
  • Potenziale erkennen: Du trackst Budgets und siehst, wo im Account mehr geht: Folgekampagnen, zusätzliche Formate, neue Produktlinien. Pitch und Angebot liegen bei Teamlead und Sales, Du lieferst Kalkulation, Kundenkontext und Deine Einschätzung zu.

Den genauen Zuschnitt zwischen beiden Blöcken legen wir gemeinsam im Gespräch fest.

Requirements

Was Du mitbringen musst

  • Mandarin verhandlungssicher, inklusive Business-Schriftverkehr: Mails, Chat-Nachrichten, Angebote und kurze Präsentationen auf Mandarin formulierst Du sicher und im richtigen Ton.
  • Dazu Deutsch oder sehr sicheres Englisch - mindestens eine der beiden Sprachen verhandlungssicher.
  • Kommerzielles Denken: Budgets, Kalkulationen, Scopes – Du kannst rechnen, weißt, was ein Kampagnen-Euro leisten muss und sagst dem Kunden auch mal freundlich nein.
  • Sicheres Auftreten gegenüber Kunden: Du präsentierst, verhandelst Timings und Umfänge und bleibst auch dann strukturiert, wenn der Kunde am Freitagabend noch eine Änderung schickt.
  • Tech-Affinität: Consumer Electronics, (Gaming-)Hardware, etc.
  • Erste Berufserfahrung in Campaign-, Influencer-, Account- oder Projektmanagement, oder in einer vergleichbaren Schnittstellenrolle zwischen China und Europa.
  • Bereitschaft, remote wie auch vor Ort in Langenfeld zu arbeiten

Nice to have

  • Erfahrung in der Kundenbetreuung mit eigener Budget- oder Umsatzverantwortung.
  • Gespür für den deutschen Creator-Markt (YouTube, TikTok, Instagram).
  • Erfahrung mit chinesischen Tech Brands oder Agenturen.
  • Kenntnis chinesischer Plattformen (Xiaohongshu, Bilibili, Douyin, RedNote).

Benefits

Benefits:

  • Ein motiviertes Team mit flachen Hierarchien und Raum für eigene Ideen, wo Du die Chance hast, Dich selbst zu verwirklichen und zu wachsen - wir pflegen ein familiäres Wachstum
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell
  • 28 Urlaubstage
  • Hochwertige technische Ausstattung mit MacBook und iPhone
  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge (bAV) bis max 4% der BBG (aktuell 322€/M) - 100% Zuschuss
  • 50€ monatlich über unsere LunyOne Spendit Card
  • Spendit Wellbeing
  • Gleitzeitmodell (Kernarbeitszeit 11:00 – 15:00 Uhr)
  • Jobauto/ Jobrad über Gehaltsumwandlung
  • bKv (300€ Budget/Jahr)
  • Corporate Benefits
  • Relocation Bonus von 964€
  • Fortbildung/ Upskilling, bis zu ca. 1.200€ p.a.
  • Regelmäßige Team-Events & -Reisen

So läuft der Prozess

  1. Bewerbung über JOIN: CV plus 3–5 Sätze zu Dir - einmal auf Mandarin, einmal auf Deutsch oder Englisch.
  2. Kennenlern-Call mit dem Campaign-Team
  3. Gespräch mit Team und Geschäftsführung, dann Angebot.

Mission Statement

Wir verbinden Brands, Creator und Communities für echten, nachhaltigen Erfolg.

Du wirst in einem energiegeladenen Umfeld mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen arbeiten. Wir suchen daher eine proaktive Persönlichkeit mit Hands-on-Mentalität, die Teil eines beweglichen Teams sein wird, das schnell auf neue Trends reagiert.

jobs.title: Marketing Manager, Europe
jobs.description:
About Andela:

At Andela, we know brilliance is evenly distributed around the world, but opportunity is not. For over 12 years, Andela has connected its customers with top global, remote technical talent from over 135 countries with the majority residing in emerging markets like Africa and Latin America.

As one of the world’s largest talent marketplaces, Andela gives companies greater flexibility to quickly deploy qualified technologists. With talent highly skilled in advanced technologies to support Application Development, Artificial Intelligence, Cloud & DevOps, Data Engineering, and much more, customers experience 33% faster project delivery. The company’s exclusive AI-powered platform, Andela Talent Cloud, is the industry’s only unified platform managing the complete global talent lifecycle and enables customers to fill individual roles or engage fully managed teams up to 66% faster.

Andela is on the precipice of two breakout industry transformations: one in staffing/hiring and the other in software development, both accelerated by generative AI.

Are you exceptional and hungry to work in a scaling business through transformation and growth? Join us and change the world.

Job Summary

As the Marketing Manager, Europe, you will be responsible for designing and executing the programs that build pipeline, strengthen brand presence, and accelerate revenue across the region. You will own end-to-end regional marketing strategy with a heavy emphasis on field events, account-based marketing (ABM), and pipeline generating campaigns that directly support the European sales team.

You will operate as a collaborative partner to specialized marketers across Andela's global team — including growth, content, design, PR, and client marketing— bringing their capabilities to bear in the European market context. This role reports into the Senior Director of Marketing GTM Strategy and is based in the UK within a commutable distance to London.

Exceptional Leadership

As an Andelan, you'll serve as a role model for the rest of the company — you do not need to manage people to be a leader at Andela! Think about the feedback your peers typically give you — if it usually sounds like the below, we want to hear from you.

  • Low ego, low drama: You share credit, take blame. You like being wrong because it means someone else had an even better idea.

  • Onedela mentality: You break silos across teams. You put the company and mission first above your team alone.

  • Great listener, hungry for feedback: You’re always seeking to improve – our product, our business, yourself. You solicit diverse opinions and deeply listen.

  • Owner, not renter: You see a problem, you fix it or find someone who will. The buck stops with you.

  • Cultivator: You enrich, you push, you make others grow. It comes from the heart, because you care.

    Key Responsibilities

Regional Event Strategy & Execution

  • Own the end-to-end planning and execution of European field events — including owned events, sponsored industry conferences, roundtables, and executive dinners — aligned to pipeline and revenue goals.

  • Build and maintain a European events calendar, managing logistics, vendor relationships, budget, and post-event follow-up to ensure measurable ROI.

  • Partner with the sales team to ensure event audiences reflect target account lists, and that every event ties to a clear pipeline outcome.

  • Track and report on event performance including attendee quality, influenced pipeline, and cost-per-opportunity.

Account-Based Marketing (ABM)

  • Partner with the Growth Marketing team to design and execute ABM programs targeting high-priority European accounts in collaboration with sales leadership.

  • Use account intelligence to both inform campaigns and support the regional sellers.

  • Measure ABM effectiveness at the account level, reporting on account engagement, pipeline created, and influenced revenue.

Pipeline Generation & Demand Generation

  • Own regional pipeline contribution targets, developing programs that generate qualified opportunities for the European sales team.

  • Build and execute integrated campaigns — across email, paid, content, and events — that move target accounts through the funnel.

  • Partner with the global Growth Marketing team to localize and adapt global campaigns for the European market, including messaging, channels, and timing.

  • Maintain a consistent drumbeat of regional campaigns, adapting quickly based on performance data and sales feedback.

Sales & Cross-Functional Partnership

Du willst Verantwortung übernehmen und Lösungen bauen, die wirklich zählen? Bewirb dich jetzt und gestalte mit uns die Energiewelt von morgen.


Deine Position

Wir suchen einen (Junior) SEO & AI Marketing Manager, der*die mit analytischem Scharfsinn und technologischer Neugier unsere Sichtbarkeit aufs nächste Level hebt. Du verstehst modernes SEO nicht als statische Optimierung, sondern als dynamisches Ökosystem, das du durch automatisierte Workflows und KI aktiv skalierst. In dieser Rolle bist du die Schnittstelle zwischen Strategie, Technik und Content. Du stellst die Website-Hygiene sicher und steuerst unsere internationalen Teams mit präzisen Briefings. 

Deine Aufgaben umfassen:

  • GEO & AEO (Modern Search): Optimierung unseres Contents für Generative Engine Optimization und Answer Engine Optimization, um in KI-gestützten Suchergebnissen (ChatGPT, Perplexity etc.) maximale Präsenz zu erzielen.

  • Automation & KI-Workflows: Eigenständige Konzeption und Weiterentwicklung von automatisierten SEO-Prozessen (z.B. automatisierte Briefing-Erstellung) unter Einsatz moderner KI-Tools.

  • Website-Hygiene & Monitoring: Aufsetzen und Überprüfen automatisierter Sanity-Checks und technischer Crawls (z.B. mit Screaming Frog) sowie das direkte Ableiten operativer Maßnahmen.

  • Keywordrecherche & Content-Implementierung: Durchführung von Keyword- und Wettbewerbsrecherchen sowie Qualitätssicherung (UX, Struktur, Scannbarkeit für KI) bei der Implementierung auf der Website.

  • Internationale Steuerung: Standortübergreifende Zusammenarbeit mit globalen Teams, um strategische Vorgaben in operative Briefings zu übersetzen und lokale Markt-Insights effizient zu nutzen.


Dein Profil

  • Berufserfahrung: Mindestens 2-5 Jahre relevante Erfahrung im Bereich SEO (Agentur oder Inhouse).

    Diverse & International Team: Work alongside a multicultural and international team across 17 different work locations within Europe and 32 nationalities, embracing diversity and a global perspective.

    Mental Health & Well-being: Access comprehensive, evidence-based mental health care with 24/7 counseling, therapy placement, on-site support, and legal and financial guidance to help you thrive at work and in life.

jobs.title: Senior Account Manager (all genders)
jobs.description:
Your mission:

  • You take strategic responsibility for a defined portfolio of mid-sized national and international B2B customers in the photovoltaic and BESS sectors, with a focus on revenue, margin, growth and long-term customer retention.
  • As a trusted point of contact, you continuously develop your customer relationships and anticipate future needs before they become concrete requirements.
  • You manage the entire sales process: from identifying opportunities and developing complex proposals to contract negotiations and closing.
  • You lead challenging negotiations at decision-maker level and work closely with your customers to develop sustainable solutions.
  • You coordinate internal partner and expert teams, prioritize resources and ensure that technical and commercial requirements are implemented efficiently.
  • You systematically develop growth and retention strategies for your customer portfolio and identify new opportunities within existing accounts.
  • You prepare well-founded sales forecasts and management reports and derive concrete actions for the further development of your portfolio.
  • You initiate and lead cross-functional projects to continuously improve and professionalize our customer management and processes.


Your profile:

  • You have a technical degree, ideally in engineering, or a comparable technical qualification, for example in energy or communications electronics.
  • You have several years of experience in strategic account management, B2B sales or managing complex customer relationships.
  • You have a proven track record of developing long-term customer relationships and growing existing accounts, ideally with responsibility for revenue, margins or growth targets.
  • You have experience negotiating complex proposals and contracts at decision-maker level and managing demanding sales processes.
  • Knowledge of photovoltaics, BESS and/or network technology is an advantage and will help you get up to speed quickly.
  • You are confident communicating in German and English and can convey both technical and commercial topics clearly to different stakeholders.
  • You work independently and in a solution-oriented way, with a strong hands-on mentality while maintaining high quality standards.
  • You want to make an impact together with us, bring your own ideas to the table and have a strong understanding of both customer needs and internal stakeholders.


You can look forward to:

6 reasons to join meteocontrol (and more):

  1. Working for a better future: With us, you will create a better future for us and all generations after us.
  2. More flexibility: We know how important a good work-life balance is. That's why we offer flexible working hours and a home office model that adapts to your needs.
  3. Vacation that grows: Start with 30 days of vacation and your loyalty will be rewarded every two years with an additional day of vacation - up to 35 days for even more time off!
  4. Continuous learning & development: Your development is important to us - we support you in your career planning within the company with a wide range of offers.
  5. Money on top: In addition to your salary, you will receive a monthly SpenditCard worth €50 and a subsidy for the Deutschlandticket.
  6. Fitness: Train with our attractive employer subsidy at EGYM Wellpass, take part in our JobRad leasing program or power yourself up at our annual company run.

... You can find many more reasons on our career website!


Your Contact Person

Camilla Geismar
Recruiting Business Partner

Du möchtest modernes Marketing mit smarten KI-Tools verbinden und das Wachstum eines innovativen FinTech-Unternehmens aktiv mitgestalten? Dann werde Teil unseres Teams und präge die Zukunft des digitalen Marketings in der WealthTech-Branche!

Ginmon ist ein führendes deutsches FinTech-Unternehmen an der Schnittstelle zwischen wissenschaftlichem Vermögensmanagement und Hochleistungstechnologie. Wir spezialisieren uns auf die digitale Vermögensverwaltung auf Grundlage wissenschaftlich fundierter ETF-Investmentstrategien. Unsere Ginmon-Plattform bietet privaten Anlegerinnen und Anlegern sowie Partnerbanken und Finanzinstitutionen einen effizienten, transparenten und professionellen Zugang zur Geldanlage und unterstützt sie dabei, ihre finanziellen Ziele nachhaltig zu erreichen. Mit unserem neuesten Produkt, apeiron, definieren wir die Vermögensberatung neu, indem wir Beratern eine hochmoderne Technologieplattform bereitstellen, die Flexibilität, Skalierbarkeit und digitale Spitzenleistung nahtlos verbindet.

Als Werkstudent (m/w/d) im Bereich Digital Marketing arbeitest du direkt mit dem CEO und dem Management von Ginmon zusammen und übernimmst eine Schlüsselrolle in der Bespielung verschiedenster Marketing Kanäle.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du arbeitest direkt mit unserem CEO sowie den Teams Business Development und Design zusammen, um Marketingstrategien für unsere Plattformen zu entwickeln.

  • Du erstellst digitalen Promotion Content für Ginmon und apeiron und vermittelst dabei kompetent Informationen rund um WealthTech und Vermögensverwaltung.

  • Du unterstützt bei der Planung, Gestaltung und Umsetzung individueller E‑Mail Marketing Kampagnen sowie der Marketing Automation für Leads und Bestandskunden.

  • Du gestaltest und veröffentlichst spannende Inhalte über verschiedene Social Media Plattformen, insbesondere LinkedIn.

  • Du nutzt ein breites Spektrum moderner Tools wie Claude for Design, Figma, Canva, Framer, Brevo und Google Analytics, um Kampagnen effizient vorzubereiten und durchzuführen sowie Arbeitsprozesse zu automatisieren.

jobs.title: Lead Software Developer in Test
jobs.description:
Our Company
At Quantum, we connect global brands with high-intent consumers. We turn intent into action and complexity into clarity.

Our Mission is clear, to help smarter, faster buying decisions. Our vision, to be the world’s most used digital comparison service, delivering value and simplicity to millions.

We drive growth through data-driven affiliate marketing built for performance from day one. Every campaign is measurable, optimised in real time, and designed to scale.

With in-house tech, full-stack analytics, and a compliance-first mindset, we give our partners an edge. We drive confident decisions and growth in regulated and high-growth sectors. We’ve helped ambitious brands grow faster, smarter, and globally.

The role

Our in-house engineering team builds and runs every product we operate. We work in two product teams, iGaming and Rewards, supported by platform and infrastructure engineers. We are partway through building a new version of our platform, which makes this the right moment to put quality engineering at the heart of how we deliver.

You will lead quality engineering across both product teams. You will guide how we test, build the frameworks and pipelines that make testing fast, and help every engineer take ownership of the quality of their own work.

This is a hands-on technical role. Early on you will write a lot of the framework code yourself. Over time your influence will come through the tooling you build and the engineers you coach.

What you'll do

  • Define our test strategy: what we test at unit, integration, contract and end-to-end level, so every team knows where a given test belongs and why.

  • Build and own our automation framework in Playwright and TypeScript, covering web front ends and APIs across both product teams.

  • Make CI feedback fast and trustworthy.

  • Bring our existing end-to-end suite to a healthy state and keep it there as the new platform grows.

  • Coach developers to write and own tests for their own code, through pairing, code review and clear examples.

  • Set up test data and environments that let teams test realistically and safely.

  • Introduce performance and load testing for our core applications.

  • Work with product managers so acceptance criteria are testable before build starts, and so testing time is part of every estimate.

  • Track a small set of quality measures, such as escaped defects, change failure rate, suite run time and flake rate, and use them to decide where to invest next.

About you

  • Strong coding skills in TypeScript or JavaScript, with test code written to the same standard as production code.

  • Deep experience with a modern browser automation framework. Playwright is ideal; Cypress experience transfers well (we’re in the process of migrating from Cypress to Playwright).

  • A track record of designing test strategy across the full testing pyramid for web products and APIs, including judging where automation earns its keep.

  • Experience running automated tests in CI (GitHub Actions ideally) with Docker, and fixing pipelines that are slow or unreliable.

  • Evidence of raising quality through other people, whether by coaching developers, setting standards or leading a quality practice.

Nice to have

  • Contract testing in a service-based architecture, for example with Pact.

  • Performance and load testing with k6, Artillery or similar.

  • Using AI coding assistants to speed up writing and maintaining tests, with the judgement to review what they produce.

  • Using observability data and production signals to decide what to test.

  • Visual regression or accessibility testing.

  • Experience in a regulated industry such as iGaming, fintech or health.

How you work

  • You explain quality trade-offs to product managers and business stakeholders in plain terms.

  • You will hold a release back when the evidence says it is not ready, and then help the team find a safe way to ship.

  • You write things down: strategies, decisions and guides other engineers can pick up and follow.

  • You are comfortable shaping a practice from an early stage, where you will need to decide what matters most first.

What You’ll Get

  • Private Health Care (Bupa)

  • Hybrid Working (3 days in office)

  • Travel Insurance

  • Competitive Base Salary

  • Company Bonus Scheme

  • Paid for AI Subscription (Claude / ChatGPT / Gemini)

  • Market-Leading Training Programme

  • Recognition & Reward Scheme

  • Annual Company Conference

  • Regular Happy Hours & Team Lunches

  • Free Coffee, Drinks & Snacks

What’s the next step?

jobs.description:
We’re on a mission to back the UK’s small businesses like no one else 🚀

Small businesses are the backbone of the economy, and we’re here to help them win. We’ve built a platform that uses clever data to get them the funding they need in minutes, not weeks.

At Funding Circle, we have the restless energy of a fintech start-up with the stability of a public company. It’s a unique mix that gives Circlers the autonomy to take ownership and the scale to make an impact that truly counts.

We’re a high-performing team that chooses to lift each other up. We challenge, we champion, and we have each other’s backs - because we know that when we stand together, we move faster and build better.

The impact is real: Last year alone, the businesses on our platform generated £7.2bn for the UK economy 📈 Come and join a mission that matters!

[Read our Impact Report] | [See our Trustpilot]

The role ⚡

📍 London (Hybrid) | 🤝 2 days in the office | 💰 Competitive Salary + Benefits

We are looking for an experienced Lead Engineer to join our Collections, Recoveries and Investor (CRI) Engineering team, part of the Multi Product Experience (MPX) group within Core Services Engineering.

CRI spans two domains - Collections, Recoveries & Litigation (CRL) and Investor Management. Our systems sit directly in the path of every loan we fund and every investor relationship we hold, so reliability isn't optional. The stack is a mix of Ruby, Clojure and Python.

As Lead Engineer, you'll bring technical authority and hands-on delivery to a team navigating change on systems foundational to how the business runs.

  • You lead your team(s) to deliver large, complex, ambiguous initiatives - brokering solution ideation across team boundaries and holding your team accountable for outcomes. With your Engineering Manager, you jointly own your team's engineering performance metrics, driving a culture of continuous improvement against them.

  • You champion engineering-led improvements across Product Engineering, proactively spotting gaps and shaping engineering-wide standards, including how to most effectively leverage AI.

  • You collaborate with your Engineering Manager and Product Manager to set the technical and product vision for your team and domain, ensuring alignment with broader Technology and business strategy.

  • You drive architectural decisions affecting your team(s) and domain, ensuring designs are durable, scalable, and secure, while referring global decisions to the appropriate forums and owning the outcomes.

  • You communicate expertly with stakeholders at all levels (including non-technical audiences) and know how to adapt your stakeholder-management style to the situation, navigating contentious conversations when they arise.

What we’re looking for 🌱

We value deep expertise, but a growth mindset and good energy are what really make our team click. We’re a group that chooses to lift each other up and think smart every day.

  • A genuine passion for mentoring and coaching, with feedback (both giving and receiving it) embedded in how you work.

  • Strong instincts for spotting cross-team friction or misalignment early, and the skill to navigate differing priorities to resolve it.

  • Experience in at least one major Programming language (e.g. Python, Ruby, Clojure).

  • Recognised technical authority in your domain, with Circlers across sub-departments seeking out your advice and trusting your judgement.

genuine fluency.

We’re building a place where everyone truly feels they belong. Even if your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every requirement, we'd still love to hear from you.

Why join us? 💜

We back you to build an incredible career and by joining us, you'll be part of one of The Sunday Times Best Companies to Work For 2026! As a flexible-first employer, we use a "best of both" approach. We’ll see you in our London office to collaborate – with barista coffee and subsidised Just Eat lunches on us!

Our Circler Proposition focuses on five areas:
